title: Tensile creep behavior of the Nb45Ta25Ti15Hf15 refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by arc-melting high-purity elemental refractory metals under vacuum (1×10⁻⁵ torr) with Ti gettering, followed by 5 remelts. Material underwent 90% cold rolling and annealing at 1373K for 1 hour in sealed stainless steel bags.
